nd89e6559cb.headline: GeoPark Announces Exclusive Negotiations for Unconventional Blocks in Vaca Muerta in Argentina
nd89e6559cb.summary: GeoPark has submitted a binding offer to acquire a non-operated unconventional block in Argentina's Vaca Muerta. The company says it has entered exclusive negotiations.
nd89e6559cb.why: Vaca Muerta is one of the largest shale oil and gas formations in the world, and acquisitions there shape Argentina's energy output and investment.

nb8de8d16c8.headline: Are we getting the full story on the Port issue?

n910ce05272.why: Fidia is an Italian industrial machinery and CNC systems maker, and its results move small-cap investor sentiment in Milan.

n58599dc2df.headline: Bundeswehr’s Rearmament to Cease Without More Funding, German Defense Chief Warns
n58599dc2df.summary: Defence Minister Boris Pistorius warned that Germany may have to halt rearmament of the Bundeswehr if next year's funding is not increased.

n94d5dfcdcc.summary: Australia is stepping up with its Future Made in Australia Act. The article notes that the US, EU, Japan, Korea and Canada have also adopted strategic economic and critical-mineral measures.
